lines.zh: 我沿着村口慢慢巡一圈。
lines.en: I take a slow patrol lap by the village gate.
I walk the rooftops with light steps.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷在风里翻起来。
lines.en: My cape flips up in the wind.
I circle the elder's house.
I pass between the white walls.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天，又低头走。
lines.en: I glance at the sky, then walk on.
I cross the village road; nobody blocks me.
I walk slowly, aura undimmed.

lines.zh: 我在村界上停了一下再走。
lines.en: I pause at the village line, then continue.

lines.zh: 我绕过种着蓝草的花坛。
lines.en: I round the planter of blue grass.
I climb high and look far.
I cross a two-block ditch in one step.

lines.zh: 我把斗篷甩到身后往前走。
lines.en: I fling my cape back and stride on.
I stand at the gate with arms folded.

lines.zh: 我的气在身体周围轻轻浮。
lines.en: My ki drifts faintly around me.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼，听村里的声音。
lines.en: I close my eyes and listen to the village.
I hold still; only my cape moves.

lines.zh: 我的拳头慢慢握紧又松开。
lines.en: My fist tightens and loosens.

lines.zh: 我站在那儿像一堵白墙。
lines.en: I stand like a white wall.

lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，气就亮了一下。
lines.en: I breathe deep and my aura flickers.

lines.zh: 我的触角感觉到风向变了。
lines.en: My antennae feel the wind turn.
I am counting the footsteps in the village.

lines.zh: 我站得笔直，没有一丝松懈。
lines.en: I stand straight, without a trace of slack.

lines.zh: 风把我的衣角吹得笔直。
lines.en: The wind pulls my hem straight.

lines.zh: 我一开口前先停了三秒。
lines.en: I pause three seconds before speaking.
I am measuring how much ki you have.
I frown, then let it go.
My look is not fierce, but it is heavy.

lines.zh: 你身上没有村庄的记号。
lines.en: You carry no mark of this village.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让你看清我的脸。
lines.en: I turn so you can see my face.

lines.zh: 我把手从背后拿到身前。
lines.en: I bring my hands from behind my back.

lines.zh: 我知道你不是这里的人。
lines.en: I know you are not from here.

lines.zh: 我点了一下头，算是招呼。
lines.en: I nod once, which counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，挡在路中间。
lines.en: I step forward and block the road.

lines.zh: 我说得很慢，每个字都清。
lines.en: I speak slowly, every word clear.
I wait for you to move first.
I am watching whether you bow.

lines.zh: 我的气在你面前收了一点。
lines.en: I draw my ki back a little before you.
I cover the place that was struck.
I clench my teeth and raise my ki.
I make no sound.
I take a deep breath and steady myself.
A bruise spreads on me.
I glare, my eyes harder now.
I press my ribs and exhale slowly.
I lean slightly, then stand straight.

lines.zh: 我看了眼你手里的东西。
lines.en: I glance at what you hold.
I do not reach out; I only look.
I shake my head and step back.

lines.zh: 我指了指村子，不是那东西。
lines.en: I point at the village, not at that.
I sniff once, uninterested.

lines.zh: 我提醒你这里的东西不属于你。
lines.en: I remind you nothing here is yours.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬下巴，让你收起来。
lines.en: I lift my chin, telling you to put it away.

lines.zh: 我盯着它看了两秒，就别开。
lines.en: I look at it two seconds, then away.

lines.zh: 我更在意你带来的动静。
lines.en: I care more about the noise you brought.
My cape sweeps your face.

lines.zh: 你被弹开半步，我退了一步。
lines.en: You stagger half a step; I take one back.
I have not moved from my spot.

lines.zh: 地面被我们踩出两个坑。
lines.en: We leave two dents in the ground.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼被你碰到的肩。
lines.en: I glance at the shoulder you touched.
You apologize; I nod.
The wind from our impact is loud.
Bump into a guard and you should apologize first.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站在村口守望。
lines.en: We stand watch side by side at the gate.
I rest my hand on her shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们对视，然后一起点头。
lines.en: We meet eyes, then nod together.

lines.zh: 我们绕着村子走了一圈。
lines.en: We walk one lap around the village.
Her ki and mine draw close.

lines.zh: 我们一起抬头看天上的云。
lines.en: We look up at the clouds together.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一个战士的礼。
lines.en: We exchange a warrior's salute.

lines.zh: 我们在同一处屋檐下停步。
lines.en: We halt under the same eaves.
She says little; I understand.

lines.zh: 我们的影子并排落在白墙上。
lines.en: Our shadows fall side by side on white wall.
I pick up a flagpole the wind knocked down.
I put the thing back where it belongs.
I gather the broken tiles.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，看了看就放好。
lines.en: I pick it up, check it, and set it down.
I hand it back to the villager.

lines.zh: 我单手就把它拎了起来。
lines.en: I lift it with one hand.
I raise it overhead to look.
I lift it lightly, with steady hands.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰间的带子。
lines.en: I tuck it into my belt.

lines.zh: 我拾起它，抖掉上面的土。
lines.en: I pick it up and shake off the dirt.
I raise my head and my ki settles.
I take one step toward the gate.
You did not come to visit.
I plant myself before the elder's house.
My aura rises an inch.
I speak, very briefly.

lines.zh: 这是那美克星人的村子。
lines.en: This is a Namekian village.

lines.zh: 我知道你带了什么进来。
lines.en: I know what you brought in.
I do not like this distance.
You turn; I turn.
I stay three blocks to your side.
I keep you on the village road.
I watch your hands, not your mouth.

lines.zh: 你上一个台阶，我跟上一个。
lines.en: You climb a step; I climb one.
I do not shout; I simply walk over.

lines.zh: 你在房子间绕，我照样跟。
lines.en: You weave between houses; I keep up.
I herd you toward the village center.
My hand stays half raised.
I drive a fist into your chest.
I sweep a palm strike across.
My elbow lands on your shoulder.
I kick your stance apart.
I strike fast and withdraw fast.

lines.zh: 那美克星的村庄，由我守着。
lines.en: I guard the Namekian village.
I knock you back three blocks.
I do not strike twice; I watch first.

lines.zh: 我的拳打在你举起的手臂上。
lines.en: My fist hits your raised arm.
I spin and kick your ribs.
I step out from behind the white wall.

lines.zh: 村口站着一个人，挡住了门。
lines.en: A figure stands at the gate, blocking it.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷落下来，站定了。
lines.en: My cape settles and I take my place.
Someone needs to guard here.

lines.zh: 我从长老的屋子里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the elder's house.
My ki arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 村道上的尘土浮起来了。
lines.en: Dust lifts off the village road.
I have taken over this post.
You hear someone land, softly.
I stand at the village boundary.

lines.zh: 我甩开火，斗篷烧了个角。
lines.en: I shake off the flame; my cape's corner burns.
My knees drop as I land.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我呛了一下。
lines.en: Water floods my mouth and I choke.
The blast slides me backward.
An arrow buries itself in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那股力量压住了我的气。
lines.en: That force suppresses my ki.
I am too hungry to raise my ki.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的身体钻进去。
lines.en: Lightning runs down through me.
